“Users aged 25–34” has no taste. A perso: “Users aged 25–34” has no taste. A person does. They own a stack of films, a playlist, a room they feel at home in, and a list of things they can't stand in software. Baste takes all of that as measurements.
The wardrobe holds your personas. Choose: The wardrobe holds your personas. Choose one, or use New persona to describe someone of your own. Fitting shows what their films, music, spaces and habits become in an interface.
The worktable has two groups: Measure co: The worktable has two groups: Measure contains Fitting, Material and Tokens; Make contains Generate, Moodboard and Taste. OpenPencil is inside Tokens. Brand kit appears for custom personas. Projects and Settings open separate views.
Check the connection indicator. Demo wor: Check the connection indicator. Demo work stays in this browser tab and resets on reload. Live means Studio reached its server; check Settings for your account and available services. Download anything you want to keep before leaving a demo.
Meet Moss, Ren and Ada on the home page. Each has a different cultural world and a conversation about their taste. The label tells you whether you are exploring an authored guided demo or an AI conversation.
When voice is available, tap Talk and al: When voice is available, tap Talk and allow microphone access. Tap Finish when you are done; you can speak for up to 45 seconds. Your audio goes to fal for transcription. Review or edit the words in the message field, then press Send. Cancel discards the recording.
Turn on Spoken replies to hear future an: Turn on Spoken replies to hear future answers, or choose Listen to reply for the latest one. The indicator distinguishes listening, thinking, preparing a voice, speaking and paused playback. Pause keeps your place; Resume continues; Stop ends playback. Switching companions or leaving the tab stops the microphone and audio.
Typing remains available when voice is u: Typing remains available when voice is unavailable or permission is denied. The conversation keeps each companion’s messages and draft while you switch, but does not save them across a page reload.
Open Material, or choose Change the clot: Open Material, or choose Change the cloth in the persona’s header. The starting material comes from their palette and aesthetic profile. Adjust the technique, colours, scale and density while watching the preview.
Changes update the persona’s header and: Changes update the persona’s header and save in this browser. Pause motion when you want to inspect a still frame. Export PNG keeps an image; Save recipe keeps the settings so you can load and revise them later.
Open Generate and leave Dry run enabled: Open Generate and leave Dry run enabled for your first attempt. Choose Asset suite or Full UI kit, then Draft the prompts. Read the image, SVG and video briefs before making images.
In the browser demo, the built-in person: In the browser demo, the built-in personas replay a recorded run, as in the recording below, and your own personas draft prompts only; nothing new is generated. With generation available, choose an image model and review your spending limit before turning off Dry run. Follow the job’s progress and reopen earlier jobs from the history.
Hosted generation covers images and judg: Hosted generation covers images and judging. A full kit also needs SVG and video services. If a service is unavailable, you can still draft prompts and continue refining your persona.
Demo boards reset on reload. If an image: Demo boards reset on reload. If an image does not load, check its source URL; your note may still be saved.
Brand kit appears for custom personas. I: Brand kit appears for custom personas. It fills with colours, fonts, a logo and imagery when you create a persona by decomposing a website. An empty kit means no website has been captured for that persona.
Compare the collected references with th: Compare the collected references with the source website before using them. Some fonts or images may be missing if the source blocks access or loads them later.
Open Taste. Enter the asset ID, explain: Open Taste. Enter the asset ID, explain Why, and optionally add tags. Choose More like this or Less like this. A useful comment names what worked or what felt wrong for this particular person.
Recent verdicts keep your explanation. T: Recent verdicts keep your explanation. The learned-taste panel collects the patterns in your feedback for later rounds. A rating guides future work; it does not edit the image you rated. Demo feedback resets when the tab reloads.
Open Tokens, then choose Edit in OpenPen: Open Tokens, then choose Edit in OpenPencil. Filter tokens searches names and values. Edit a value directly, or use the colour picker for a colour. Choose Save document to keep the changes.
A base persona keeps its original measur: A base persona keeps its original measurements; its editable document is separate. Demo document changes stay in this tab and do not update the downloadable token examples. Native file export and file watching require a local installation.
Website capture needs a connected servic: Website capture needs a connected service. If Decompose is unavailable, keep the reference URL on your moodboard and continue with a persona of your own.
Weave them together creates a persona fr: Weave them together creates a persona from both sets of influences when the service is available. Choose different personas. Remix is unavailable in the browser demo.
Open Settings to check your connection a: Open Settings to check your connection and account. If the indicator says Demo, changes stay in this tab. Download your token exports before reconnecting, since reconnecting starts a new work session.
On a hosted Studio, choose your availabl: On a hosted Studio, choose your available model in Generate. Connection addresses, provider keys and server defaults are covered in Developer docs for people running their own installation.
In Settings, choose Sign in / create pro: In Settings, choose Sign in / create profile when it is available. Your account is what you use to return to your work. A design persona is the person you are designing for; it is separate from your account profile.
Your wallet shows available credit and p: Your wallet shows available credit and purchase offers. Review the price at checkout. When you return to Studio, refresh the wallet to check that the credit has arrived before starting generation.
If sign-in or checkout is unavailable, u: If sign-in or checkout is unavailable, use the demo and download your exports. The recorded tours do not show a purchase or paid generation.
Demo personas, references, feedback and: Demo personas, references, feedback and documents stay in the current tab. Switching Studio tabs keeps them; reloading or reconnecting clears them. Files you download remain on your device.
Material adjustments are saved in this b: Material adjustments are saved in this browser. Save recipe gives you a reusable file; Export PNG gives you an image. Keep both if you want to revise the material later.
Use Projects with a connected account to: Use Projects with a connected account to keep a brief and its design history. Check for a successful save before closing the page. If a save fails, keep your draft and retry after the connection returns.
Work missing after a reload: check wheth: Work missing after a reload: check whether you were using Demo. That session is temporary, but downloaded files and saved material recipes remain available.
No new colours after editing a persona i: No new colours after editing a persona in Demo: the demo reuses its built-in examples. An empty Brand kit means no website has been captured. A broken moodboard image may need a new source URL.
Generation blocked: refresh your account: Generation blocked: refresh your account and check the model, balance and maximum spend. Reduce the number of candidates if the plan exceeds your limit. You can continue drafting prompts while generation is unavailable.
